name: ChatAgentive – AI Chatbot for Customer Support & Lead Generation
author: Chatagentive

sections.description:
ChatAgentive is a powerful AI chatbot plugin for WordPress that helps businesses automate customer conversations, provide instant support, engage website visitors, and generate more leads — all from a single intelligent chat interface.

Easily connect your ChatAgentive AI agent to your WordPress website and deliver 24/7 automated customer experiences without writing any code.

Key Features

  • AI-powered customer support chatbot
  • Lead generation and visitor engagement automation
  • Simple setup using your Agent ID
  • Lightweight and optimized performance
  • Enable or disable chatbot directly from WordPress admin
  • Secure widget loading
  • Mobile-friendly and responsive
  • Translation-ready
  • Works with modern WordPress themes

Why ChatAgentive?

ChatAgentive helps businesses automate repetitive conversations, improve response times, and increase conversions with intelligent AI agents trained on your business content.

Perfect for:
* Customer support
* SaaS businesses
* Ecommerce stores
* Agencies
* Startups
* Lead generation websites
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/chatagentive directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings → ChatAgentive.
  4. Enter your ChatAgentive Agent ID.
  5. Save settings and your AI chatbot will appear on your website.
sections.faq:
Where do I find my Agent ID?

You can find your Agent ID inside your ChatAgentive dashboard under Agent Settings.

Does this plugin slow down my website?

No. ChatAgentive is lightweight and optimized for performance.

Is coding required?

No coding is required. Simply add your Agent ID and activate the chatbot.
